ABOUT ME

A builder.

THE THREAD THROUGH MY CAREER

I like building things.

My career has taken me from building sales teams and new markets to strategic brokerage partnerships and a revenue organization built from founder-led selling.

The work I’m drawn to involves creating structure, developing people, building relationships, and taking ownership of a result. That is the opportunity I see at Elliman.

FAMILY & HOME

My people.
